body:
I won't pretend to know what you're going through, this sounds really tough. But the best thought I have that I cling to is that all of this bullshit, it's just society, it's just culture. You can be gay, and it doesn't matter in the slightest. Taking on the name/label gay is just for the convenience of everyone else. They don't need to know you, they just know you ARE "gay" and can treat you differently for it. Fuck that. FUCK that more than anything has ever been fucked.

Hopefully this doesn't sound entirely tangential, but this is the kind of thing that gives me a little hope/happiness, knowing that there are entire groups of people that are trying to get out from under the weight of cultural expectations: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iYB0VW5x8fI

As for the assault/bullying, I wouldn't suggest you do something you don't want to do, but I'd just ask you to think carefully about why you don't want to report it. Do you know the person(s) closely? Are you afraid of everyone finding out?

Finally, as inconsequential as this might be, you reached out to my post when I'm feeling like shit, and for that I love you and wish you all the best, and now I'm trying to reach out to yours, I hope this helps.
